stages.headline: The lateral area of a right prism is the base perimeter times the height: S(lat) = P · h.
stages.headlineEnglish: The lateral area of a right prism is the base perimeter times the height: S(lat) = P · h.

stages.headline: The total area adds both bases: S(total) = S(lat) + 2S(base).
stages.headlineEnglish: The total area adds both bases: S(total) = S(lat) + 2S(base).

stages.headline: Example: a regular triangular prism with base side 4 and height 10: S(lat) = 120, S(base) = 4√3, S(total) = 120 + 8√3.
stages.headlineEnglish: Example: a regular triangular prism with base side 4 and height 10: S(lat) = 120, S(base) = 4√3, S(total) = 120 + 8√3.
